Everton Manager David Moyes Praises Squad Mentality After Carabao Cup Win

01 Nov 2026, 07:59 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.bbc.com

Toffees Secure Quarter-Final Spot

Everton manager David Moyes praised the mentality of his squad following a 3-1 victory against Newcastle in the Carabao Cup on Thursday. According to the source report, the win at Hill Dickinson Stadium advanced Everton to the quarter-finals of the tournament.

Following the completed fixture, Everton are scheduled to visit League Two side Fleetwood Town in the next round of the competition.

Match and Competition Details

  • Competition: Carabao Cup
  • Teams: Everton and Newcastle
  • Venue: Hill Dickinson Stadium
  • Match Date: Thursday (source-confirmed completed match)
  • Result: Everton 3, Newcastle 1

Squad Discipline and Response

Ahead of the fixture, attention focused on the exclusion of Jack Grealish. According to reported claims from the club, the omission was due to a "breach of club discipline."

  • Manager Stance: David Moyes supported the decision in post-match comments but declined to provide further details regarding the disciplinary matter.
  • Team Focus: Moyes credited the remaining players for maintaining their focus and delivering one of their strongest performances of the season despite the pre-match attention.

"The one thing about Everton and what they've got is really good values behind them," Moyes stated, as reported by the source. "All the players stand up to the values and accept the values we put out there."

Verification and Practical Implications

Readers seeking to verify the original announcements and fixture updates can consult official club channels for Everton and Fleetwood Town, as well as official tournament coverage from the Carabao Cup organizers.
